name: Mezuka Auto Poster
long_caption: A powerful automation tool that lets you schedule messages and auto-post to multiple WhatsApp groups simultaneously. Set custom intervals, manage templates, and track delivery status — all from a simple dashboard. Works with Mezuka MD V5 bot sessions seamlessly.

name: Group Scraper Pro
short_caption: Extract all member numbers from any group
long_caption: Instantly extract phone numbers from any WhatsApp group you're a member of. Export to CSV or TXT format. Includes deduplication, country code filtering, and bulk export. Essential for marketers and community managers who need clean contact lists.

name: Sticker Pack Creator
short_caption: Batch convert images to WhatsApp stickers
long_caption: Convert any image or animated GIF into a WhatsApp sticker pack in seconds. Supports batch processing of up to 30 stickers per pack, auto-resizing, background removal, and custom pack metadata. Integrates directly with your Mezuka bot for instant deployment.

name: Bulk Message Blaster
short_caption: Send personalized messages to contact lists
long_caption: Upload a contact list and send personalized messages at scale. Supports variable substitution (name, number), media attachments, scheduled sending, and rate-limiting to avoid bans. The safest and most effective bulk messaging tool for Mezuka users.

name: Analytics Dashboard
long_caption: A beautiful web dashboard that visualizes your Mezuka bot's performance: message count, active sessions, command usage, peak hours, group activity, and more. Connects directly to your MongoDB instance. Export reports as PDF or CSV. Dark mode, fully responsive.

name: Media Downloader CLI
short_caption: Download from 50+ platforms via command line
long_caption: A fast CLI tool to download media from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, Spotify and 45+ more platforms. Supports audio extraction, quality selection, playlist downloads, subtitle embedding, and thumbnail downloads. Built on yt-dlp with Mezuka optimizations.

name: Chat Backup Manager
short_caption: Export and backup all WhatsApp conversations
long_caption: Securely backup all your WhatsApp conversations, media, and documents to local storage or cloud (Google Drive, Dropbox). Supports selective backup by contact or group, incremental backups, encryption, and easy restore. Never lose important messages again.

name: AI Response Generator
short_caption: GPT-powered smart auto-replies for your bot
long_caption: Integrate powerful AI-generated responses into your Mezuka bot. Uses GPT-4 API to generate context-aware replies, answer questions, write content, and hold conversations. Configurable personality, knowledge base injection, and conversation memory. The future of WhatsApp automation.
